segments.text: Welcome to our final lesson. We've covered what to wear, PPE, safety equipment, behavior and chemical safety.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到最后一课。我们已经讲过了穿什么、个人防护装备、安全设备、行为规范和化学品安全。

segments.text: But there are a few other general lab hazards we need to address and they're just as important to know.
segments.zh: 但还有其他几种常见的实验室危害需要讨论，了解它们同样重要。

segments.text: First is electrical shock. Keep in mind that many pieces of equipment in the lab operate at very high voltages.
segments.zh: 首先是触电。要记住，实验室里的许多设备都在非常高的电压下运行。

segments.text: So keep water and liquids away from instruments.
segments.zh: 所以要让水和液体远离仪器。

segments.text: Never attempt to repair or open any cover while an instrument is plugged in.
segments.zh: 仪器插着电源时，绝不要尝试维修或打开任何外壳。

segments.text: Routinely inspect your equipment, check for frayed electrical cords and only use approved extension cables or power switches.
segments.zh: 定期检查你的设备，检查电线是否有磨损，只使用经过认可的延长线或电源开关。

segments.text: The next hazard is burns. Many lab instruments like the autoclave operate at high temperatures and can cause burns.
segments.zh: 下一种危害是烧烫伤。许多实验室仪器，比如高压灭菌器，都在高温下运行，可能造成烫伤。

segments.text: Use heat resistant gloves whenever handling hot materials.
segments.zh: 处理高温材料时，一定要使用耐热手套。

segments.text: If you're using the GCMS, lower the temperature set points before opening the cover.
segments.zh: 如果你使用的是 GCMS，在打开盖子之前要先调低温度设定值。

segments.text: Extremely low temperatures can also damage unprotected skin.
segments.zh: 极低的温度也会损伤未加防护的皮肤。

segments.text: Wear insulated gloves when handling dry ice or items stored in the minus 80 degree freezer.
segments.zh: 处理干冰或存放在零下 80 度冰箱里的物品时，要戴隔热手套。

segments.text: Slips, trips and falls can cause very serious injuries.
segments.zh: 滑倒、绊倒和跌倒可能造成非常严重的伤害。

segments.text: Most of the time, these hazards can be avoided.
segments.zh: 大多数时候，这些危害是可以避免的。

segments.text: Keep floors and routes of movement through the lab clear of any obstructions.
segments.zh: 保持地面和实验室内的通行路线畅通，没有任何障碍物。

segments.text: Never place any materials or instruments on the floor, not even temporarily.
segments.zh: 绝不要把任何材料或仪器放在地上，哪怕是暂时的也不行。

segments.text: Clean up spills immediately and use wet floor signs to warn your colleagues.
segments.zh: 立即清理洒出物，并使用“小心地滑”的标志提醒同事。

segments.text: Be aware of your surroundings.
segments.zh: 注意你周围的环境。

segments.text: Look out for shelves, table tops or any other structures that could cause a head injury if you bump into them.
segments.zh: 留意架子、桌面或其他任何撞上后可能造成头部受伤的结构。

segments.text: Compressed gas cylinders are under extreme pressure.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶承受着极高的压力。

segments.text: If they're damaged, the cylinder may be propelled at extremely dangerous speeds.
segments.zh: 如果它们损坏了，气瓶可能会以极其危险的速度被推射出去。

segments.text: Some gas cylinders, such as hydrogen, are also extremely flammable.
segments.zh: 有些气瓶，比如氢气瓶，还极其易燃。

segments.text: Secure gas cylinders with a heavy duty clamp and strap.
segments.zh: 用重型夹具和绑带固定气瓶。

segments.text: The cylinder's head should be sealed with a threaded protective cap whenever it's not in use.
segments.zh: 气瓶不使用时，瓶头应该用带螺纹的保护帽封好。

segments.text: Most accidents that occur in the lab tend to be minor and are caused by workers who ignore or just forget the safety procedures.
segments.zh: 实验室里发生的大多数事故往往都是小事故，是由忽视或干脆忘记安全规程的人员造成的。

segments.text: However, serious, even fatal accidents can and do occur.
segments.zh: 然而，严重甚至致命的事故是可能发生的，而且确实会发生。

segments.text: You can do your part to minimize the risk of both minor and major accidents by following the safety rules.
segments.zh: 遵守安全规则，你就能尽自己的一份力，把大小事故的风险都降到最低。

segments.text: Keep an eye out for your co-workers, too. Make sure they're working safely.
segments.zh: 也要留意你的同事，确保他们在安全地工作。

segments.text: Good science begins with safe science.
segments.zh: 好的科学始于安全的科学。

segments.text: Be safe. Take care.
segments.zh: 注意安全，保重。
